top5.title: Jensen Huang steps down as Nvidia CEO
top5.description: Nvidia’s longtime CEO resigned after two affairs and an internal investigation aimed in part at determining whether he had been the target of a foreign intelligence operation. Nvidia has appointed an interim CEO.
top5.why: Jensen Huang’s reported resignation would represent a major leadership shock for Nvidia and could affect investor confidence, chip strategy, and the global AI supply chain.

top5.title: Anthropic signs up to $4.3 billion in cloud agreements with Microsoft
top5.description: Anthropic has expanded its cloud computing agreements with Microsoft for up to $4.3 billion. The company is seeking additional infrastructure capacity ahead of its planned IPO.
top5.why: Anthropic’s potential $4.3 billion expansion of its Microsoft cloud commitments underscores the escalating infrastructure costs and strategic dependence shaping the AI market.

top5.title: U.S. data center electricity demand is growing ten times faster than the grid
top5.description: U.S. data center electricity demand has risen by about 19% annually since 2000, compared with 2% for grid capacity. According to Howden, data centers may need to obtain up to 58% of their electricity off-grid by 2030.
top5.why: Data-center electricity demand is growing far faster than grid capacity, making power availability a major constraint on AI expansion and a rising policy and investment issue.

top5.title: Europe seeks to ban dark patterns and loot boxes for minors
top5.description: The proposed Digital Fairness Act notably targets difficult-to-cancel subscriptions, addictive design, ads aimed at minors and personalized pricing. Fines could reach 6% of global turnover.
top5.why: Europe’s proposed Digital Fairness Act could impose substantial new obligations and fines on companies over dark patterns, addictive design, targeted advertising, and personalized pricing.

top5.title: Google launches Gemini Decision, a model specialized in decision-making
top5.description: Gemini Decision 1 responds with yes or no, multiple choice, or a rating, along with a confidence score, based on text, images, audio, video, or PDFs. It can process up to 1,000 questions in 150 to 250 milliseconds.
top5.why: Google’s Gemini Decision launch signals a shift toward high-throughput AI systems designed to make standardized judgments across multimodal enterprise data.
